name: x25519_keygen
title: A random 32-byte seed becomes an X25519 key through the Rust openssl crate.

origin.description: A random 32-byte seed becomes an X25519 key through the Rust openssl crate.
origin.details: Two fresh X25519 keys derive the same 32-byte secret in both directions. The keys are not compared.
origin.value: The same value R returns for this call.

translation.description: A random 32-byte seed becomes an X25519 key through the Rust openssl crate.
translation.details: Two fresh X25519 keys derive the same 32-byte secret in both directions. The keys are not compared.
translation.value: The same value R returns for this call.
translation.example:
from openssl import x25519_keygen, x25519_diffie_hellman

def one():
    a = x25519_keygen()
    b = x25519_keygen()
    sec = x25519_diffie_hellman(a, b.pubkey)
    other = x25519_diffie_hellman(b, a.pubkey)
    return "32" if sec == other and len(sec) == 32 else "bad"
print(one())
